title: eval(harness): add prompt-set regression gating and CI metrics hooks
author: Priya Nair
description:
Motivation: Prevent regressions introduced by prompt-set changes and give teams deterministic CI gates for eval quality. This PR introduces a CI-facing regression gate for prompt-sets, adds a small set of standardized eval metrics exported to the CI system, and hooks to fail/signal PRs when quality thresholds are breached.

What this does: - Adds a prompt-regression gate runner that compares baseline eval results against HEAD for canonical prompt-sets. - Exposes aggregated metrics (pass_rate, mean_score, per-prompt delta) to CI as JSON and as GitHub check annotations. - Adds a lightweight quality_gating configuration per prompt-set (thresholds for mean_score drop, per-prompt failure rate, and flaky prompt flags). - Implements retry/rerun semantics for flaky evaluation shards and a noise-tolerant significance test (bootstrap-based) before failing the gate. - Adds documentation and a sample prompt-set config with recommended thresholds.

Files touched: summary below.

Checklist:
- [x] Add CI hooks and runner (eval_harness/ci/hooks.py)
- [x] Add metrics exporter and annotation integration (eval_harness/ci/annotations.py)
- [x] Add quality gating config and defaults (eval_harness/prompt_sets/quality.yaml)
- [x] Update README and quickstart for teams (docs/eval_ci_gating.md)
- [x] Tests: unit tests for gate logic and integration smoke test (tests/test_ci_gate.py)
- [x] Linear: ENG-2041, ENG-2107 referenced

Testing and rollout: Ran full eval-suite against the nightly baseline (2026-02-18 snapshot). The gate was exercised on a handful of internal PRs; we tuned thresholds to avoid false positives for small-model variance. Default config is conservative; teams can opt into stricter gates per-folder. CI will annotate diffs and provide a quick link to the full eval artifact in the build logs.

Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the runner synchronous in CI (small prompt-sets) and provides an async mode for larger workloads. Future follow-ups: 1) add automatic baseline refresh cadence, 2) add per-model rollup impressions for multi-model deployments, 3) wire the metrics into the Console for historical tracking.
